nodes.label: Semantic Cache
nodes.rationale: Reuse prior ticket predictions when title and description embeddings are sufficiently similar, reducing unnecessary LLM calls; description similarity is weighted more heavily than title similarity.

nodes.label: Hybrid Embedding API
nodes.rationale: The cache compares dense embeddings for both title and description, while preserving sparse payloads for compatibility with the embedding service response.
